scorecard.coaching: Failed standard opening and closing branding scripts.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at turn 42 for router model which was already provided at turn 3.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem

grader.scenario: Broadband intermittent disconnections caused by faulty power supply adapter barrel plug; unresolved
grader.notes: Poor call marked by failed branding, rude accusations, refusal to replace faulty power adapter, and repeated questioning in the last third, with handled empathy.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent failed standard opening branding ('Good afternoon, broadband technical line...') and closing branding.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Nadia throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I understand how terrifying and stressful it is to have your connection cut out during intensive care hospital bed allocations...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the power plug fault in own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for router model at turn 42 despite customer stating S-Net Hub 4 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent stonewalled customer and demanded £39.99 for replacement adapter.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you place your sensitive broadband router on a wobbly hallway table where people kick the cables, of course the power plug is going to loosen.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on power drops and barrel socket behavior.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Hardware remained loose, no replacement was dispatched, and customer disconnected dissatisfied.
